method.cold: new Chromium process per artifact/codec/transport/network/repeat; HTTP cache disabled
method.warm: same process, retained encoded buffer (explicit) or decoded buffer (HTTP); includes engine module cache effects
method.endpoint: decoded SHA-256 verified and WebAssembly.compile resolved; no runtime instantiation or user first output
method.http: native Content-Encoding decoding is included in fetchMs; cannot separate decoder CPU time
method.scheduling: serial samples; rotate codec and transport order across repetitions
